Results.ReviewText:
My two previous Weber Grills (lasting a total of 40+ years) were charcoal and set a very high standard for me.  My new E-325 propane grill, although only a few weeks old, is on track to maintain that standard.  It arrived in perfect condition, not assembled and with all the parts, in an indestructible box.  Assembly took me slightly more time than indicated, but was easy enough for a DIYer.  The assembled grill is very sturdy, unlike some of the grills I have seen in stores.  I have used it perhaps 10 times already on a variety of food products (vegetables, poultry, fish, meat) and have been pleased with the results in all cases.  The burner  controls make it easy to maintain an even temperature, the grates are easy to remove and clean, and the fold-down side tables make a small footprint for storage.  

There is one drawback for me.  There are only two wheels included; one end of the grill must be lifted in order to move the grill.  This may be more of an issue for me since I store the grill after every use.  If only Weber would send me another complete wheel assembly for the other end, I would be extremely happy with my conversion for charcoal to propane!!!
Results.Title: Just perfect, except...

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Works very well. We have had it for 2 months. Lowes assembled and delivered it to my patio. Have owned a Weber before for 15 years but it was the smaller 2 burner. These grills are built to last

Results.ReviewText: Have owned Weber products for over 20 years so when it became time to replace my old Silver A I again turned to Weber. Product has changed. This is my first 3 burner which is what I required to better control the low and slow cooking I wanted for ribs on the grill. The porcelain coated grates were a necessity to give me the heated top for grill marks and the sear feature will get it's use often. The look of the Spirit is good, the control knobs are well positioned in front, the tank is hidden, all good things. The only disappointing aspect is the removable pan is not aluminum but heat treated painted metal. One of main reasons I chose Weber years ago was the removable pan.  The Spirit still offers this feature however it is in the back so I need to turn the grill around when it is time to clean which is a bit inconvenient. My old Weber grills the aluminum pan just slid out the front. I guess I shouldn't complain but the jury is still out on replacing the pan from aluminum to heat treated painted metal so I need to be careful not to scratch the pan.
Results.Title: After 20 Years still buying Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I love the compact design of this grill.  The cooking  surface is a dream to clean.  The reflective cover on the burners provide even heating and the sear feature gives me the perfect steak.
